P S B & Associates LLP was established in 2013 by founding partners CA Pavan S. Toshniwal and CA Bharadwaj R. Mandhane. CA Sagar S. Nikam is the third member of the partner team.

View more about our practiceView less

The firm provides services to clients in India and abroad. Our team of chartered accountants and other professionals works under partner guidance across assurance, accounting and payroll outsourcing, tax planning, financial planning, company formation, business setup and financing.

Our practice serves clients in India and abroad, including Indian and multinational corporates, banking and financial institutions, startups, high-net-worth individuals, executives and expatriates. Our sector coverage also includes hospitals and healthcare organisations, maritime and transportation businesses, and builders and developers.
